<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex026012026-11-0609-34-18" status="reviewed" ana="corpusmd:colophon">
			<milestone unit="section" n="Post-colophon annotation"/>
            <lb edRef="inst:4652" n="198a4"/> chan gyi yige 'di dag kyang rgya bod kyi brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi shing rta chen po'i srol la gces spras bya ba dang | de dag la ma gus pa dang khyad gsod pa mngas dang | 
			nga (srod rang)? gis ma rig par nga rgyal gyis dregs nas rang dga' dang gzu lums su smra ba spang pa'i phyir dang | 
			bstan pa dang 'gro ba la phan sems kyis brtul zhugs mchog la gnas shing? <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:6525">lung dang rigs pa smra ba'i dge slong rdo rje grags</rs> kyis bkod pa'o ||</seg></TEI>
